title: ToolCall
description: Deterministic tool invocation record: one call from an agent episode with bounded arguments. Tools never reason or call an LLM; they receive arguments, query stores, and return structured results (Fase 1, DEC-002).

episode_id.description: Episode that triggered this call. May differ from the episode that records the result when the call spans multiple turns.

tool_name.description: Deterministic tool. New tools extend this enum by superseding the schema.

arguments.description: Bounded input arguments for the tool. Schema varies per tool_name; validated at runtime by the tool implementation.

error.description: Error message when status is failed; null otherwise.
